chunks: The day We shall gather from every community a section of those who denied Our signs, and they will be brought (in separate groups),

key_terms.يُوزَعُونَ: they will be segregated/brought in groups

ai.seo_question: How are people gathered on the Day of Judgment according to Surah An-Naml?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of collective accountability, where the 'fawj' (group) represents those who stubbornly adhered to their leaders' falsehoods, linking individual denial to communal identity. The phrase 'hum yuza'oon' (they will be segregated) is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as indicating a forced, distinct gathering separate from the believers, emphasizing the tangible reality of the Hereafter. This highlights the transition from individual responsibility to the weight of communal legacy in divine judgment.
